data_fields.name: check_cadence
data_fields.donor_constant: instant (default when goals are set), turnStart, or turnEnd

data_fields.name: damage_goal_threshold
data_fields.donor_constant: default 1 (largest single blow must reach this)

data_fields.name: damage_goal_can_destroy
data_fields.donor_constant: default true (a destroyed gear counts as met unless set to false)

data_fields.name: goal_fail_text
data_fields.donor_constant: author text per goal; the donor default is an undefined name (nil)

data_fields.name: crate_turn_bonus
data_fields.donor_constant: 5000 ms added to the turn timer per collected crate (Teamwork mission only)

best_idea: A mission is a list of goals (each met, not yet, or impossible, with its own fail text) plus non-goals that lose at once, checked on a chosen cadence from facts the engine events record per unit.
decision_why: Keep the goal list as data, the three-way result, the non-goal list and the check cadence; keep the author's fail text; drop the Lua-only pairs order and the shared ended flag; write facts from the server kill record into the one ledger.
acceptance: A server test sets an objective list of one single-hit goal (a boss takes one blow of 40 or more) and one non-goal (an escort dies); the duel stays open until the blow lands, a dead escort ends it with the author's text, and a goal failure shows the author's text, not an empty reason.
